label: METAPHYSICAL_GROUNDING_2: Grounds a b is the separately interpreted directed relation of a…
definition: Grounds a b is the separately interpreted directed relation of a grounding b, using Fact tokens. It is distinct from material implication, Forms.Explains, efficient causation and epistemic identification. Neither asymmetry nor actuality follows from the interface alone.
note: Modern analytical test vocabulary for issue #260. The primary passages motivate the question, not these formal definitions. A sourced replacement would require a passage specifying these precise relations and restrictions. Lean locator: Explanation.Grounds is the separately supplied Fact → Fact → Prop field, not the enclosing Explanation structure or a definition of implication. Its grounding interpretation and applicability remain OPEN; no structural law follows from having the field.

formal_gap.meaning: Explanation.Grounds a b says that the fact a metaphysically grounds the fact b: b obtains in virtue of a, a directed relation of dependence between facts (base facts, participation facts, exemplification facts). It is part of a modern test vocabulary for the participant-selection objection (#260), supplied by an Explanation; nothing is attributed to Plato or Aristotle.
examples: A test case: a base fact about a bearer's feature grounding that bearer's participation in a Form, under the unattributed commitment GroundedSelection.
Ordinary grounding illustration: the fact that a set has members grounding the fact that it is nonempty.
exclusions: Material implication: a true conditional between facts is not grounding.
Formative change (Produces), an agent's identification (Identifies) and the shared Forms.Explains relation: separate senses in DISAMB-PARTICIPATION-EXPLANATION.
Efficient causation between beings: grounding relates facts, not agents.
open_obligations: Asymmetry is the optional norm AsymmetricGround, not a law of the field; irreflexivity, transitivity and well-foundedness are likewise not imposed.
Whether any real participation facts stand in this relation, and whether it applies to Plato's account, remain OPEN.
No formalization candidate: grounding is taken as primitive in this vocabulary.
